Title: EditHistoryTests.NewHistory_HasNothingToUndoOrRedo
Description: A new undo history reports nothing to undo or redo, has no labels, and refuses both operations.

Title: EditHistoryTests.Undo_RestoresStateBeforeEdit_AndRedoReturnsToCurrent
Description: Undo hands back the state from before the edit with its label, and redo returns to the state that was current at undo time.

Title: EditHistoryTests.Undo_WalksBackInOrder
Description: Repeated undos restore earlier states newest-first with the matching labels.

Title: EditHistoryTests.Push_DiscardsRedoBranch
Description: Recording a new edit after an undo throws away the redo step.

Title: EditHistoryTests.DiscardIfUnchanged_DropsOnlyAMatchingTopEntry
Description: An unchanged edit is dropped only when the newest undo entry matches the current state; older entries are never compared or removed.

Title: EditHistoryTests.Push_BeyondCapacity_DropsOldestEntries
Description: Past the 200-step limit the oldest undo step is evicted, so exactly 200 undos are possible and the very first state is gone.

Title: EditHistoryTests.Clear_EmptiesBothStacks
Description: Clearing the history removes all undo and redo steps.

Title: EditorSessionTests.NewSession_IsCleanWithNoHistory
Description: Opening a level gives the right name and rooms, no unsaved changes, no undo/redo, and no selection.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Edit_MarksDirty_AndUndoingItClearsDirty
Description: Adding a room marks the level as unsaved with an "Add Room" undo label; undoing removes the room, clears the unsaved flag, enables redo and shows an "Undo Add Room" notice.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Redo_ReappliesTheEdit
Description: Redo puts an undone room back in the same place, marks the level unsaved again and shows a "Redo Add Room" notice.

Title: EditorSessionTests.UndoAndRedo_WithNothingRecorded_ReturnFalse
Description: Undo and redo with an empty history do nothing and show no notice.

Title: EditorSessionTests.NewEdit_AfterUndo_DiscardsRedo
Description: Making a new edit after an undo removes the ability to redo.

Title: EditorSessionTests.MultipleEdits_UndoInReverseOrder
Description: Moving the vacuum start, removing a wall and renaming a room undo one at a time in reverse order, ending with no unsaved changes.

Title: EditorSessionTests.CheckpointWithoutAChange_LeavesNoUndoStep
Description: Starting an edit (e.g. grabbing a point) and finishing it without changing anything leaves no undo step and no unsaved changes.

Title: EditorSessionTests.LiveDrag_IsOneUndoStep_AndOnlyRaisesLiveChangesUntilCommit
Description: Dragging the wall thickness slider sends live updates while dragging, one final update on release, and undoes as a single step.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Edit_RaisesLevelAndDocumentChanged
Description: A normal edit notifies the UI exactly once that the level changed and once that the document changed.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Save_WritesTheLevel_AndClearsDirty
Description: Saving writes the level (with its new name and rooms) to its file and clears the unsaved flag.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Undo_PastASave_MarksDirtyAgain
Description: Undoing past a save marks the level unsaved; redoing back to the saved state clears the flag.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Rename_TrimsInput_AndIgnoresBlankOrUnchanged
Description: Renaming the level trims spaces, ignores blank, null or unchanged names, and records only real renames for undo.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SelectRoom_InvalidIndex_ClearsSelection
Description: Selecting a room that doesn't exist clears the selection instead of keeping a bad index.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SelectionChanged_OnlyFiresOnActualChange
Description: Selecting the same room twice or clearing an empty selection doesn't send extra selection-changed notifications.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SelectingADoorway_DeselectsTheRoom_AndViceVersa
Description: A room and a doorway can't be selected at the same time; selecting one deselects the other.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Undo_DropsASelectionThatNoLongerExists
Description: Undoing the addition of the selected room clears the selection so it doesn't point at a missing room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.ToolChanged_FiresOncePerChange
Description: Switching tools notifies once; choosing the tool that is already active does not.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Options_ClampAndNotify
Description: Editor options clamp bad values (negative floor index, zero snap increment) and only notify when a value actually changes.

Title: EditorSessionTests.AddRoom_UsesCurrentFloorAndWallDefaults_AndSelectsIt
Description: A new room uses the current floor covering and the "new rooms have walls" setting, gets the next room name, and becomes selected.

Title: EditorSessionTests.AddRoom_SkipsNamesAlreadyInUse
Description: Automatic room names skip any "Room N" name already taken by another room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.DeleteRoom_RemovesItsDoorways_AndUndoBringsThemBack
Description: Deleting a room also deletes its doorways, renumbers the remaining ones, clears the selection and shows a notice; undo restores the room and all doorways.

Title: EditorSessionTests.DeleteRoom_InvalidIndex_RecordsNothing
Description: Deleting a room that doesn't exist does nothing: no undo step and no notice.

Title: EditorSessionTests.DuplicateRoom_PlacesACopyBesideTheOriginal
Description: Duplicating a room places a selected "copy" just to the right of the original, keeps its deleted walls, and doesn't share its outline data.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SetRoomFloor_ChangesCovering_AndBecomesThePaintFloor
Description: Changing a room's floor covering is undoable and becomes the covering for the next new room; picking the covering it already has records nothing.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SetWall_RemovesAndRestoresOneWall
Description: A single wall can be removed and restored with matching undo labels; removing an already-removed wall records nothing.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SetAllWalls_TogglesEveryEdge
Description: Removing or adding all walls affects every edge of the room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.InsertVertex_KeepsWallFlagsOnTheRightEdges
Description: Adding a corner to a room keeps deleted walls on the correct edges, and undo restores the original corners and walls.

Title: EditorSessionTests.RemoveVertex_StopsAtATriangle
Description: A room can't lose corners below three; the refused removal isn't recorded for undo.

Title: EditorSessionTests.PlaceDoorway_NearAWall_SnapsOntoIt
Description: Clicking near an outer wall snaps a default-width doorway onto it, links it to that room and "Outside", and selects it.

Title: EditorSessionTests.PlaceDoorway_AwayFromWalls_IsRefused
Description: Clicking far from any wall places no doorway, records nothing, and tells the user to click on a wall.

Title: EditorSessionTests.PlaceDoorway_OnASharedWall_LinksBothRooms
Description: A doorway placed on a wall shared by two rooms links both of those rooms.

Title: EditorSessionTests.MoveDoorwayLive_RelinksToTheNewWall_WithoutRecordingHistory
Description: Dragging a doorway onto a different shared wall relinks it to the rooms on that wall, without adding undo steps mid-drag.

Title: EditorSessionTests.MoveDoorwayLive_OffEveryWall_KeepsItsLinks
Description: Dragging a doorway away from every wall moves it but keeps its existing room links.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SetDoorwayWidthLive_ClampsToSensibleWidths
Description: Doorway width is clamped between the minimum and maximum allowed widths.

Title: EditorSessionTests.DeleteSelection_RemovesTheSelectedDoorway
Description: Delete with a doorway selected removes it, clears the selection and records a "Delete Doorway" undo step.

Title: EditorSessionTests.WallStrokes_CanBeDrawnFoundAndDeleted
Description: Free-standing walls can be drawn, clicked on (hit-tested) and deleted; deleting an invalid index is ignored and delete is undoable.

Title: EditorSessionTests.SetWallColor_SameColour_RecordsNothing
Description: Setting the wall colour to its current value records nothing; a new colour applies and is undoable.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Snap_RoundsToTheGrid
Description: With corner snapping off, points round to the nearest grid step, including negative coordinates.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Snap_PrefersANearbyCornerOverTheGrid
Description: A point close to an existing room corner snaps to that corner instead of the grid.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Snap_CornerReachScalesWithZoom
Description: Corner snapping reach is measured in screen pixels: a corner too far away when zoomed in is in reach when zoomed out.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Snap_IgnoresTheCornerBeingDragged
Description: While dragging a corner (or a whole room), snapping ignores that corner (or room) but still snaps to other corners.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Snap_WithEverythingOff_ReturnsThePoint
Description: With grid and corner snapping both off the point is returned unchanged.

Title: EditorSessionTests.FindVertex_ReturnsTheClosestCornerWithinTolerance
Description: Clicking finds the nearest room corner within the tolerance, and returns nothing when too far away or for a missing room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.TryFindEdge_ProjectsOntoTheNearestEdge
Description: Clicking near a room edge finds that edge and the closest point on it; nothing is found far from edges or for a missing room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.TryFindAnyEdge_SearchesEveryRoom
Description: Edge hit-testing across the whole level finds the right room and edge in rooms other than the first.

Title: EditorSessionTests.NearestWall_GivesDistanceAndDirection
Description: Returns the distance to the closest wall and that wall's direction.

Title: EditorSessionTests.FindDoorway_WithinTolerance
Description: Clicking near a doorway finds it; clicking elsewhere finds nothing.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_SampleApartment_IsClean
Description: The built-in sample apartment produces no validation issues.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_EmptyLevel_PromptsForARoom
Description: An empty level gives exactly one warning: "Draw a room to get started."

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_SelfCrossingRoom_IsAnError
Description: A room whose outline crosses itself is reported as an error on that room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_RoomWithTooFewCorners_IsAnError
Description: A room with fewer than 3 corners is reported as an error on that room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_SpawnOutsideEveryRoom_Warns
Description: A vacuum start point outside every room gives a warning.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_RoomWithNoDoorwayPath_Warns
Description: A room the vacuum can't reach through doorways gives a warning naming that room.

Title: EditorSessionTests.Validate_DoorwayNotOnAWall_Warns
Description: A doorway that isn't on any wall gives a warning that it opens nothing.

Title: LevelDataTests.GetRoom_OutOfRange_IsNull
Description: Looking up a room by an out-of-range index returns null instead of throwing.

Title: LevelDataTests.RoomIndexAt_FindsContainingRoom_LaterRoomsWinOverlaps
Description: Finds which room contains a point (or none when outside), and where rooms overlap the later room wins.

Title: LevelDataTests.ReachableFrom_FollowsDoorways
Description: Walking through doorways reaches every connected room from any starting room, and nothing from an invalid room.

Title: LevelDataTests.UnreachableRooms_ListsRoomsCutOffFromSpawn
Description: Removing the only doorway to a room makes it show up as unreachable from the vacuum start.

Title: LevelDataTests.UnreachableRooms_IsEmpty_WhenSpawnIsOutside
Description: When the vacuum starts outside every room, no rooms are listed as unreachable (a separate warning covers that case).

Title: LevelDataTests.NeighboursOf_IgnoresDoorwaysToOutside
Description: Doorways leading outside aren't counted as connections to another room.

Title: LevelDataTests.RemoveRoom_DropsItsDoorways_AndReindexesTheRest
Description: Removing a room deletes its doorways and renumbers the room links on the remaining doorways.

Title: LevelDataTests.RemoveRoom_OutOfRange_DoesNothing
Description: Removing a room with an invalid index leaves rooms and doorways unchanged.

Title: LevelDataTests.WallThickness_HasAFloor_AndDrivesDoorwaySnapDistance
Description: Wall thickness can't go below 0.01 m, and the doorway snap distance is the larger of the wall thickness and 0.12 m.

Title: LevelDataTests.Bounds_OfEmptyLevel_IsADefaultViewport
Description: A level with no rooms reports a default 10 x 10 m area centred on the origin.

Title: LevelDataTests.TotalFloorArea_SkipsInvalidRooms
Description: Total floor area and level bounds ignore rooms with fewer than 3 corners.

Title: LevelDataTests.FloorTypeAt_UsesPalette_OrNullWithout
Description: The floor covering under a point comes from the floor palette; it is null without a palette or outside every room.

Title: LevelDataTests.RectangleOutline_KeepsSizeAndCentreAtAnyRotation
Description: A generated rectangle room keeps its area, centre and side length at 0, 37 and 90 degrees of rotation (3 cases).

Title: LevelDataTests.RegularOutline_HasAtLeastThreeSides_OnTheRadius
Description: A generated regular polygon always has at least 3 sides, with every corner on the requested radius.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.Complement_WithoutGaps_IsTheWholeLine
Description: With no doorway gaps, the whole wall line stays solid.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.Complement_SplitsAroundAGap
Description: A single doorway gap splits a wall into the solid pieces on either side.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.Complement_MergesOverlappingGaps_InAnyOrder
Description: Overlapping doorway gaps are merged correctly even when given out of order.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.Complement_ClampsGapsHangingOffTheEnds
Description: Gaps that extend past the ends of a wall are clipped to the wall, and a gap covering the whole wall leaves nothing solid.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_OneSegmentPerWalledEdge
Description: A simple 4 x 3 m room produces four wall segments totalling 14 m.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_OfNullLevel_IsEmpty
Description: Generating walls for a missing level returns no segments instead of throwing.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_SkipsDeletedWalls
Description: A deleted wall produces no wall geometry.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_DoorwayCutsAGapOfItsWidth
Description: A 1 m doorway on a wall cuts a 1 m gap in exactly the right place.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_DoorwaySlightlyOffTheWall_StillCuts
Description: A doorway a few centimetres off a wall still cuts through it.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_DoorwayFarFromWalls_CutsNothing
Description: A doorway far from every wall doesn't remove any wall.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_IncludesFreeStandingWalls
Description: Free-standing walls are included in the wall geometry, and zero-length ones are dropped.

Title: LevelGeometryTests.CollectWallSegments_SharedWallDoorway_OpensBothRooms
Description: A doorway on a wall shared by two rooms cuts the wall of both rooms by the doorway's width.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.UniqueName_KeepsAFreeName
Description: A level name that isn't taken is used as-is.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.UniqueName_NumbersPastTakenNames_IgnoringCase
Description: Taken level names get a number ("Kitchen 2", "Kitchen 4" …), and name matching ignores upper/lower case.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.Write_CreatesTheFolder_AndLeavesNoTempFile
Description: Saving a level creates missing folders, leaves no temporary file behind, and can be read back.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.Write_ReplacesAnExistingFile
Description: Saving over an existing level file replaces it without leaving extra files.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.Read_FileThatIsNotALevel_ReturnsNull
Description: Reading a file that isn't a level returns nothing instead of crashing.

Title: LevelLibraryTests.Delete_RemovesTheFile_AndIgnoresMissingOnes
Description: Deleting a level removes its file, and deleting a file that is already gone doesn't throw.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.SerializeThenParse_PreservesEverything
Description: Saving a level to JSON and loading it back keeps the name, rooms, corners, floors, deleted walls, doorways, free-standing walls, wall thickness, wall colour and vacuum start.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.FromLevel_IsADeepCopy
Description: Changing a copied level doesn't affect the original level.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.ApplyTo_ReplacesTheLevelsContents
Description: Loading a saved level into an existing one fully replaces its rooms, doorways, walls and settings.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.Parse_UnreadableInput_ReturnsNull
Description: Null, empty, whitespace, non-JSON and truncated JSON all load as nothing instead of throwing (5 cases).

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.Parse_RepairsMissingAndOutOfRangeValues
Description: Loading repairs bad data: a blank name gets the default, negative wall thickness and zero doorway width are clamped, and missing wall flags default to walls.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.Parse_EmptyObject_GivesAnEmptyUsableLevel
Description: An empty JSON object loads as a usable empty level with the default name.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.ToJson_RoundTrips
Description: Converting a saved level to JSON and back produces identical JSON.

Title: LevelSnapshotTests.Summaries_MatchTheLevel
Description: The room count, floor area and bounds shown for a saved level match the live level, ignoring invalid rooms.

Title: Poly2DTests.SignedArea_IsPositiveCounterClockwise_NegativeClockwise
Description: Polygon area is positive for counter-clockwise outlines, negative for clockwise ones, and unsigned area is the same either way.

Title: Poly2DTests.Area_OfDegenerateInput_IsZero
Description: A missing outline or one with fewer than 3 points has zero area.

Title: Poly2DTests.Area_OfConcaveOutline
Description: An L-shaped (concave) room has the correct area.

Title: Poly2DTests.Centroid_OfSquare_IsItsMiddle
Description: The centre of a square is its middle.

Title: Poly2DTests.Centroid_FallsBackToAverage_ForFewOrCollinearPoints
Description: For empty, two-point or flat (collinear) outlines the centre falls back to the average of the points.

Title: Poly2DTests.ContainsPoint_RespectsConcavity
Description: Point-in-room checks work for L-shaped rooms: points in the notch are outside, and outlines with fewer than 3 points contain nothing.

Title: Poly2DTests.DistanceToSegment_ReportsDistanceAndClampedPosition
Description: Distance from a point to a wall is correct, with the position along the wall clamped to its ends.

Title: Poly2DTests.DistanceToSegment_OfZeroLengthSegment_IsPointDistance
Description: A zero-length wall measures distance to its single point without dividing by zero.

Title: Poly2DTests.Bounds_EnclosesEveryPoint
Description: The bounding box encloses every point, and a missing outline gives an empty box.

Title: Poly2DTests.IsSimple_DetectsSelfIntersection
Description: Squares, L-shapes and triangles are valid outlines; a bow-tie (self-crossing) outline, too few points or a missing outline are not.

Title: Poly2DTests.Triangulate_ConcaveOutline_CoversExactlyItsArea
Description: An L-shaped room triangulates into the right number of counter-clockwise triangles covering exactly its area, for both winding directions (2 cases).

Title: Poly2DTests.Triangulate_TooFewPoints_ReturnsEmpty
Description: A missing outline or one with fewer than 3 points produces no triangles.

Title: Poly2DTests.PointInTriangle_IncludesEdges
Description: Points inside or exactly on a triangle's edge count as inside; points beyond it don't.

Title: RoomTests.SyncWallEdges_AddsWallsForNewEdges_AndTrimsExtras
Description: A room always has exactly one wall flag per edge: missing flags are added as walls and extra flags are trimmed.

Title: RoomTests.HasWall_OutOfRange_IsFalse
Description: Asking about a wall on an edge that doesn't exist returns false instead of throwing.

Title: RoomTests.SetWall_ToggleWall_AndSetAllWalls
Description: Individual walls can be removed and toggled back, all walls can be removed at once, and an invalid edge is ignored.

Title: RoomTests.InsertVertex_BothHalvesInheritTheSplitEdgesWall
Description: Adding a corner splits an edge into two halves that both keep that edge's wall setting, so a deleted wall stays deleted.

Title: RoomTests.InsertVertex_InvalidEdge_DoesNothing
Description: Adding a corner on an edge that doesn't exist changes nothing.

Title: RoomTests.RemoveVertex_KeepsWallFlagsAlignedWithEdges
Description: Removing a corner keeps the number of wall flags equal to the number of edges.

Title: RoomTests.RemoveVertex_NeverLeavesFewerThanThreeCorners
Description: A triangle room refuses to lose another corner and stays valid.

Title: RoomTests.EdgeEnd_WrapsToFirstVertex
Description: The last edge of a room ends at its first corner.

Title: SampleLevelsTests.Apartment_RoomsAreSimpleAndDoorwaysSitOnWalls
Description: In the sample apartment no room outline crosses itself, and every doorway sits on the walls of both rooms it connects.

Title: SampleLevelsTests.PopulateBlank_ReplacesExistingContent
Description: Starting a blank level replaces any existing content with a single room, no doorways or free-standing walls, and the vacuum start inside the room.
